# Pull Request Template

## Description
Please describe the changes you're proposing.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Site/structure change
- [ ] Test addition
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Other

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the contributing guidelines
- [ ] My code follows the project's code style
- [ ] I have added or updated documentation as needed
- [ ] I have type-checked my changes
- [ ] I have linted my changes
- [ ] I have added tests if applicable
- [ ] My change does not break existing functionality

## Zazie Productions Aesthetic Check
Does this change preserve / enhance the SNEEV / Zazie Productions aesthetic? How does it fit the conceptual framework?

## Screenshot / Demo
If applicable, include GIFs or screenshots of the change in action.

## Branching Note
Changes should be made on the `arena/01a0656f-sn33v` branch and opened as a pull request from that branch.
